scenario: 欺诈检测里正例（欺诈）占比 <1%。你训了个模型，报告 99.9% 准确率，团队很兴奋。但一个「永远预测不是欺诈」的空模型也有 99.9% 准确率。
scenario_en: In fraud detection positives (fraud) are <1%. Your model reports 99.9% accuracy and the team is thrilled — but a model that always predicts 'not fraud' also hits 99.9%.
q: 为什么这里不能用准确率评估，该看什么？
q_en: Why is accuracy the wrong metric here, and what should you look at?
why: 极端偏斜下多数类主导准确率：全预测多数类就有 99.9% 准确率却抓不到一个欺诈，准确率被 prior 灌水、毫无判别力。该看 precision/recall 和 PR 曲线——它们直接反映稀有正例被抓到多少、误报多少。
why_en: Under extreme skew the majority class dominates accuracy, so always-majority scores 99.9% while catching zero fraud; look at precision/recall and PR curves instead.
tradeoff: 准确率(被多数类灌水、掩盖漏抓) vs precision/recall(直接量稀有正例抓到多少、误报多少)
diagram:
flowchart TD A["全预测'不是欺诈'"] --> B["准确率 99.9%
看着很棒"] A --> C["召回率 0%
一个欺诈没抓到"] C --> D["改看 precision/recall + PR 曲线"]
options: 准确率没问题，99.9% 就是很好的模型，稀有类少本来就该少关注它
准确率被 prior 灌水，该看 precision/recall 与 PR 曲线
该改用 ROC-AUC，它综合所有阈值下的表现，在偏斜比例下也能公正反映稀有类真实水平
问题只是阈值没调好，把决策阈值从 0.5 降到 0.1 准确率就会更真实
options_en: Accuracy is fine — 99.9% is a great model, and rare classes deserve little attention anyway.
Accuracy is inflated by the prior; look at precision/recall and PR curves.
Switch to ROC-AUC — it aggregates performance across every threshold, so it fairly reflects rare-class performance at any level of skew.
The only issue is a bad threshold; dropping the decision threshold from 0.5 to 0.1 makes accuracy truthful.
whenOtherWins: 如果类别大致均衡（如 50/50 的情感分类），准确率就是合理的首选指标，不需要专门看 PR 曲线。
optionExplanations: 稀有类往往正是业务重点（漏一笔欺诈损失巨大），用准确率等于奖励模型忽略最该抓的那一类。
对；分母被海量真负例撑大，一句「全说没事」就刷到 99.9%，必须换成直接量正例的指标。
虽然它综合了所有阈值，但极端偏斜下仍会因大量真负例把 TPR 抬得虚高、显得乐观，正是本章明确不推荐的。
调阈值改变的是工作点，不改准确率被 prior 主导的本质，换个阈值它依旧掩盖漏抓。
optionExplanations_en: The rare class is often the business point (missing one fraud costs a lot), so accuracy rewards the model for ignoring exactly what matters most.
Correct — the denominator is dominated by vast true negatives, so 'always safe' scores 99.9%; switch to metrics that measure positives directly.
It does aggregate across every threshold, but under extreme skew many true negatives still inflate TPR, looking overly optimistic — exactly what the chapter warns against.
Tuning the threshold moves the operating point but not accuracy's prior-domination, so a different threshold still hides missed positives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 各类在数据中的天然占比，如欺诈 <1%；极端偏斜时会主导准确率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The class prior is each class's natural frequency in the data (e.g. fraud <1%), which dominates accuracy under extreme skew.

termDefinitions.meaning: precision=预测为正里真正正的比例；recall=真正正里被抓到的比例，稀有类评估的核心。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the fraction of predicted positives that are truly positive; recall is the fraction of true positives caught — core for rare-class evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在不同阈值下画 precision 对 recall 的曲线，偏斜数据下比 ROC 更能反映真实表现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A PR (Precision-Recall) curve plots precision against recall across thresholds, more informative than ROC under skew.

scenario: 一个欺诈模型用标准交叉熵在 0.5% 正例的数据上直接训练，不做任何处理。
scenario_en: A fraud model is trained straight with standard cross-entropy on data with 0.5% positives, no handling.
q: 类别不平衡会同时损害哪些方面？(多选)
q_en: Which aspects does class imbalance simultaneously harm? (multiple)
why: 不平衡不止损害精度：它让多数类主导损失（退化成多数标签规则）、破坏校准（预测概率偏离真实率）、损害评估有效性（测试集正例太少，P/R 不可信）、并扭曲业务指标。它不影响的是硬件成本这类与数据分布无关的东西。
why_en: Imbalance lets the majority dominate the loss, corrupts calibration and evaluation validity, and distorts business metrics.
options: 多数类主导损失，模型退化成「总预测多数标签」的平凡规则
校准被破坏：预测出的概率不再等于真实发生率
评估有效性受损：测试集里正例太少，precision/recall 不可信
训练所需的 GPU 显存翻倍，硬件成本随不平衡线性上升
options_en: The majority class dominates the loss, degrading the model into a trivial 'always predict the majority label' rule.
Calibration is corrupted: predicted probabilities no longer match true occurrence rates.
Evaluation validity suffers: too few positives in the test set make precision/recall unreliable.
Training GPU memory doubles, and hardware cost rises linearly with the imbalance.
optionExplanations: 对；交叉熵按样本数加权，0.5% 正例的梯度被淹没，模型学到「全说负」就是损失最低的平凡解。
对；偏斜 prior 让模型系统性低估正例概率，输出的 0.9 未必对应 90% 真实率，下游阈值/成本决策全被误导。
对；测试集正例本就寥寥，随机波动就能让 recall 大起大落，评估结论不可信。
错；显存和硬件成本取决于模型规模和 batch，与类别比例无关，不是不平衡的后果。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — cross-entropy weights by sample count, so 0.5%-positive gradients drown and 'always negative' becomes the lowest-loss trivial solution.
Correct — a skewed prior makes the model systematically underestimate positive probability, so an output of 0.9 need not mean a 90% true rate, misleading downstream thresholds and cost decisions.
Correct — with so few test positives, random fluctuation swings recall wildly, making evaluation conclusions untrustworthy.
Wrong — memory and hardware cost depend on model size and batch, not class ratio, so it is not a consequence of imbalance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型输出概率与真实发生率一致的程度；校准好则「预测 0.9」约等于「真实 90%」。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration is how well predicted probabilities match true rates; well-calibrated means a 0.9 prediction is about 90% real.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分类常用损失，按样本逐个求和，偏斜下会被多数类样本主导。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cross-entropy is the standard classification loss summed per sample, dominated by the majority class under skew.

scenario: 中度不平衡的表格数据，你想让训练集里少数类多一些。可选随机过采样（复制少数类）或 SMOTE（在少数类近邻间插值造新点）。
scenario_en: Moderately imbalanced tabular data; you want more minority samples in training. Options: random oversampling (duplicate minority) or SMOTE (interpolate new points between minority neighbors).
q: 随机过采样 vs SMOTE，在过拟合风险这一维上差别是什么？
q_en: Random oversampling vs SMOTE — how do they differ on overfitting risk?
why: 随机过采样只是复制少数类，模型会反复看到一模一样的样本、记住这些副本 → 过拟合；SMOTE 在少数类样本与其 k 近邻之间插值，造出新的合成点，增加了多样性、过拟合更轻。代价是 SMOTE 在高维里插值可能生成不真实的样本。
why_en: Random oversampling duplicates minority points so the model memorizes copies and overfits, while SMOTE interpolates novel synthetic points that reduce overfitting.
tradeoff: 随机过采样(简单、平衡但记副本易过拟合) vs SMOTE(造新点少过拟合但高维插值可能不真实)
options: 两者都只是复制少数类，过拟合风险完全一样，唯一的区别是 SMOTE 跑得更慢
随机过采样复制样本、易记副本过拟合；SMOTE 插值造新点，过拟合更轻
SMOTE 复制原样本、随机过采样造新点，所以 SMOTE 更容易过拟合
随机过采样造新点、SMOTE 删除多数类，两者都不改变少数类的数量
options_en: Both merely duplicate minority points, so overfitting risk is identical and the only difference is that SMOTE runs slower.
Random oversampling duplicates samples so copies are memorized; SMOTE interpolates new points, so it overfits less.
SMOTE duplicates originals and random oversampling makes new points, so SMOTE overfits more.
Random oversampling creates new points and SMOTE deletes the majority, so neither changes the minority count.
optionExplanations: 错；机制不同风险就不同：复制副本必然比插值新点更易过拟合，不是「完全一样」。
对；关键差异在样本新颖度——副本没带来新信息、模型背下它们，插值点是没见过的合成样本，泛化更好。
说反了：SMOTE 才是插值造新点、随机过采样才是复制，这个选项把两者机制对调了。
全错：随机过采样是复制不是造新点，SMOTE 是插值不是删多数，两者都在增加少数类。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — different mechanisms mean different risk: duplicating copies is inherently more overfit-prone than interpolating new points, not identical.
Correct — the key difference is sample novelty: copies add no new information and get memorized, while interpolated points are unseen synthetic samples that generalize better.
Backwards: SMOTE interpolates new points and random oversampling duplicates; this swaps their mechanisms.
All wrong: random oversampling duplicates rather than creates, SMOTE interpolates rather than deletes majority, and both add minority samples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在一个少数类样本和它的 k 近邻之间线性插值，合成新的少数类样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SMOTE (Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique) linearly interpolates between a minority sample and its k nearest neighbors to synthesize new minority points.

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接复制少数类样本使各类数量平衡，简单但易过拟合副本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Random oversampling duplicates minority samples to balance classes — simple but prone to overfitting the copies.

scenario: 你在一个 500 维的特征空间上跑 SMOTE 合成少数类样本，发现模型加了合成数据后反而更差。
scenario_en: You run SMOTE to synthesize minority samples in a 500-dimensional feature space and find the model gets worse after adding the synthetic data.
q: SMOTE 在高维空间的问题是什么？
q_en: What goes wrong with SMOTE in high dimensions?
why: SMOTE 靠在近邻间线性插值造样本，但高维里「近邻」本身意义就弱（维度诅咒下点两两几乎等距），在 500 维插值出的点很可能落在真实数据流形之外，等于往训练集灌噪声。所以 SMOTE 更适合维度可控、有真实局部结构的场景。
why_en: SMOTE interpolates between neighbors, but in high dimensions neighbors are meaningless (curse of dimensionality) so 500-d interpolation lands off the real data manifold — effectively noise.
options: 高维里 SMOTE 会自动退化成随机过采样，只是复制样本、没有坏处
高维里近邻意义弱，插值出的点落在真实数据流形之外，等于给训练集灌噪声
高维里 SMOTE 生成的样本永远比原样本更真实，问题只在于计算太慢
SMOTE 只在高维有效，低维反而不能用，本例应该增加更多特征
options_en: In high dimensions SMOTE auto-degrades into random oversampling, just duplicating samples with no downside.
In high dimensions neighbors are meaningless, so interpolated points land off the real data manifold — effectively injecting noise into the training set.
In high dimensions SMOTE's samples are always more realistic than originals; the only problem is slow computation.
SMOTE works only in high dimensions and cannot be used in low ones, so here you should add more features.
optionExplanations: SMOTE 不会退化成复制——它仍在插值，只是插出的点变得不真实，坏处恰恰在这里。
对；维度诅咒让高维近邻几乎等距，两点连线中点脱离真实流形，合成样本变噪声，越加越差。
恰恰相反，维度越高插值样本越不真实，问题不是速度而是样本质量。
反了：SMOTE 在维度可控时才好用，高维是它的失效区，加特征只会让维度诅咒更严重。
optionExplanations_en: SMOTE does not degrade into duplication — it still interpolates, but the interpolated points become unrealistic, which is exactly the harm.
Correct — the curse of dimensionality makes high-d neighbors near-equidistant, so the midpoint of a segment leaves the real manifold and the synthetic sample becomes noise that worsens the model.
The opposite — higher dimensions make interpolated samples less realistic, and the problem is sample quality, not speed.
Backwards: SMOTE works when dimensions are manageable and fails in high-d; adding features only deepens the curse of dimensionality.

termDefinitions.term: curse of dimensionality / 维度诅咒
termDefinitions.meaning: 高维空间里点两两距离趋于相等，「近邻」失去区分意义，距离型方法退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The curse of dimensionality makes pairwise distances nearly equal in high-d, so 'nearest neighbor' loses meaning and distance-based methods degrade.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真实样本在高维空间中实际分布的低维曲面，脱离它的点即不真实样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The data manifold is the lower-dimensional surface real samples actually occupy in high-d; points off it are unrealistic.

scenario: 少数类在特征空间里有一部分离决策边界很近、很难学，你想让合成样本重点补在这些难学区域。
scenario_en: Part of the minority class sits near the decision boundary and is hard to learn; you want synthetic samples concentrated in those hard regions.
q: SMOTE vs ADASYN，合成样本放在哪里的策略不同？
q_en: SMOTE vs ADASYN — how do they differ in where they place synthetic samples?
why: SMOTE 大体均匀地在少数类各处插值；ADASYN 自适应地把更多合成样本放在「最难学」的少数类样本附近（即被多数类包围、贴近边界的点），针对复杂区域加密。代价是边界重叠区往往也有噪声，ADASYN 会连噪声一起放大。
why_en: SMOTE interpolates fairly uniformly across the minority, while ADASYN adaptively places more synthetic points near the hardest-to-learn minority samples at the boundary.
tradeoff: SMOTE(均匀补少数类、稳) vs ADASYN(自适应补难学边界、针对性强但放大重叠区噪声)
options: 两者放置策略相同，ADASYN 只是 SMOTE 的更快实现，结果分布一致
SMOTE 大体均匀插值；ADASYN 把更多合成点放在最难学的边界附近
SMOTE 只在边界处合成、ADASYN 均匀合成，正好和它们的设计目标相反
ADASYN 删除边界样本、SMOTE 增加边界样本，两者作用方向完全相反
options_en: Their placement is the same; ADASYN is just a faster SMOTE implementation with an identical output distribution.
SMOTE interpolates fairly uniformly; ADASYN puts more synthetic points near the hardest-to-learn boundary samples.
SMOTE synthesizes only at the boundary and ADASYN synthesizes uniformly, the reverse of their design goals.
ADASYN deletes boundary samples while SMOTE adds them, so the two work in exactly opposite directions.
optionExplanations: 两者分布不同：ADASYN 按学习难度加权、把密度堆到边界，不是 SMOTE 的等价加速版。
对；ADASYN 用「邻域里多数类越多=越难学」来分配合成量，把火力集中在决策边界的复杂区域。
说反了：ADASYN 才是聚焦边界、SMOTE 才是均匀，这个选项把两者的策略对调了。
全错：两者都是过采样（增加少数类合成样本），没有谁在删样本。
optionExplanations_en: Their distributions differ: ADASYN weights by learning difficulty and piles density at the boundary, not an equivalent faster SMOTE.
Correct — ADASYN allocates synthesis by 'more majority in the neighborhood = harder,' concentrating firepower on the boundary's complex regions.
Backwards: ADASYN focuses on the boundary and SMOTE is uniform; this swaps their strategies.
All wrong: both are oversampling (adding minority synthetics); neither deletes samples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自适应过采样：按少数类样本的学习难度分配合成量，难学的边界点附近合成更多。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ADASYN (Adaptive Synthetic sampling) allocates synthesis by learning difficulty, generating more points near hard boundary minority samples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型区分两类的分界面，边界附近的样本最难分类、信息量最高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The decision boundary is the surface separating classes; samples near it are hardest to classify and most informative.

scenario: 你的数据在决策边界附近两类严重重叠（overlap region），既有真少数类也有被错标或天然模糊的点。你用 ADASYN 在这里加密合成样本。
scenario_en: Your data has heavy two-class overlap near the boundary (overlap region), mixing true minority points with mislabeled or inherently ambiguous ones. You densify with ADASYN here.
q: 在重叠区用 ADASYN 的主要风险是什么？
q_en: What is the main risk of using ADASYN in the overlap region?
why: ADASYN 专挑「难学」的点加密，而重叠区难学往往是因为样本本身是噪声，合成会把噪声一起放大、扭曲决策边界。更稳的做法是 SMOTE + Tomek links，先合成再擦掉边界上的模糊对。
why_en: ADASYN targets hard points, but in the overlap region hard often means noisy, so densifying there amplifies noise and distorts the boundary.
options: ADASYN 会自动识别并跳过噪声点，所以在重叠区反而最安全
ADASYN 挑难学点加密，重叠区的难学多因噪声，合成会放大噪声
ADASYN 在重叠区只会欠采样多数类，不产生任何新样本，没有风险
风险只是训练变慢，重叠区计算量大，但对模型质量没有任何影响
options_en: ADASYN auto-detects and skips noisy points, so it is safest in the overlap region.
ADASYN densifies hard points, but overlap-region hardness usually means noise, so synthesis amplifies that noise.
In the overlap region ADASYN only undersamples the majority and creates no new samples, so there is no risk.
The only risk is slower training; the overlap region is compute-heavy but model quality is untouched.
optionExplanations: ADASYN 无法区分「难因为信息量高」还是「难因为是噪声」，它不会跳过噪声，反而往噪声上堆样本。
对；难学=邻域里多数类多，这在重叠区恰好命中噪声/模糊点，围着它们合成等于给噪声加权，边界更歪。
ADASYN 是过采样、只加合成样本，不做欠采样，这句把它的机制说错了。
问题是质量不是速度：放大的噪声会实打实地把决策边界推偏，模型变差。
optionExplanations_en: ADASYN cannot tell 'hard because informative' from 'hard because noise'; it does not skip noise but piles samples onto it.
Correct — hard means many majority neighbors, which in the overlap region hits noisy/ambiguous points, so synthesizing around them weights the noise and skews the boundary further.
ADASYN is oversampling and only adds synthetics; it does not undersample, so this misstates its mechanism.
The issue is quality, not speed: the amplified noise genuinely biases the decision boundary and degrades the model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征空间里两类样本混杂难分的区域，常含噪声或天然模糊样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The overlap region is where two classes intermix and are hard to separate, often containing noisy or inherently ambiguous samples.

scenario: 两类在边界处贴得很近、互相纠缠，你想在过采样之后把边界「擦干净」一点，减少模糊的贴脸样本对。
scenario_en: Two classes hug the boundary and tangle; after oversampling you want to clean the boundary by removing ambiguous face-to-face pairs.
q: Tomek links 是什么，怎么用它清理边界？
q_en: What are Tomek links, and how do they clean the boundary?
why: Tomek link = 分属不同类却互为最近邻的一对样本，它们贴在决策边界上最容易混淆；移除这对里的多数类成员就把边界擦清晰。常与 SMOTE 连用：先平衡再擦边界。
why_en: A Tomek link is a pair of opposite-class points that are each other's nearest neighbor; removing the majority member sharpens the boundary.
options: Tomek links 是把同类最近邻合并成一个代表点，用来压缩多数类的规模
Tomek links = 互为最近邻的异类样本对；删掉其中的多数类成员擦清边界
Tomek links 是在少数类内部插值造新点，本质上和 SMOTE 完全相同
Tomek links 随机丢弃一半多数类样本，靠减量来平衡类别比例
options_en: Tomek links merge same-class nearest neighbors into one representative point to compress the majority.
Tomek links are pairs of opposite-class points that are mutual nearest neighbors; drop the majority member to sharpen the boundary.
Tomek links interpolate new points inside the minority class, which is essentially identical to what SMOTE does.
Tomek links randomly drop half the majority samples, balancing by sheer reduction.
optionExplanations: Tomek link 关注的是跨类的最近邻对、不是同类合并，这句把定义弄错了。
对；互为最近邻却异类=骑在边界上的混淆对，删掉其中多数类成员既平衡又擦清边界，是informed undersampling。
Tomek 是欠采样清理、不造新点，和 SMOTE 的插值合成完全相反。
它不是随机丢弃，而是精准删除边界上的多数类混淆点，删得有目标而非盲目减量。
optionExplanations_en: A Tomek link concerns cross-class nearest-neighbor pairs, not same-class merging, so this misdefines it.
Correct — mutual nearest neighbors of different classes are confusing pairs on the boundary; deleting the majority member both balances and sharpens the boundary, an informed undersampling move.
Tomek is undersampling cleanup and creates no new points, the opposite of SMOTE's interpolation.
It is not random dropping but targeted removal of confusing majority points on the boundary — purposeful, not blind reduction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分属不同类且互为最近邻的一对样本，位于决策边界；清理时删掉多数类成员。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Tomek link is a pair of opposite-class points that are mutual nearest neighbors on the boundary; cleanup removes the majority member.

termDefinitions.term: informed undersampling / 有信息欠采样
termDefinitions.meaning: 按位置/难度有选择地删多数类（如 Tomek、ENN），而非随机丢弃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Informed undersampling removes majority samples selectively by position/difficulty (e.g. Tomek, ENN) rather than at random.

scenario: 你想再做一次更激进的边界清理：把那些「被自己的近邻多数投票判成异类」的多数类样本也删掉。
scenario_en: You want a more aggressive boundary cleanup: also drop majority samples that their own neighbors' majority vote would classify as the other class.
q: edited nearest neighbors (ENN) 删的是哪些样本？
q_en: Which samples does edited nearest neighbors (ENN) remove?
why: ENN 移除那些被自己 k 近邻多数投票错分的多数类样本——它们要么落在少数类领地里、要么本身是噪声，删掉能让多数类分布更干净、边界更清晰。它和 Tomek links 都属于有信息的欠采样，只是判据不同（近邻投票 vs 互为最近邻对）。
why_en: ENN removes majority samples misclassified by their own k-nearest-neighbor majority vote, cleaning the majority distribution and the boundary.
options: 删除少数类中被近邻正确分类的样本，减少少数类冗余
随机删除固定比例的多数类样本，与近邻关系无关
删除被自己 k 近邻多数投票错分的多数类样本
删除所有位于特征空间中心的多数类样本，只保留边缘点
options_en: Remove minority samples correctly classified by their neighbors to reduce minority redundancy.
Randomly remove a fixed fraction of majority samples, with no reference to neighbors.
Remove majority samples that their own k-nearest-neighbor vote misclassifies.
Remove all majority samples at the center of feature space, keeping only edge points.
optionExplanations: ENN 清理的是多数类、不是少数类，且目标是删「被近邻判成异类」的点，不是删正确分类的。
ENN 的删除有明确判据（近邻投票错分），不是随机按比例丢，这点正是「有信息」欠采样的意义。
对；被自己近邻投票判成异类的多数类点，要么闯进了少数类领地、要么是噪声，删掉让边界更干净。
ENN 依据的是近邻一致性、不是几何中心/边缘位置，这句判据完全不对。
optionExplanations_en: ENN cleans the majority, not the minority, and targets points its neighbors vote as the other class, not correctly classified ones.
ENN's removal has a clear criterion (neighbor-vote misclassification), not a random fraction, which is precisely what makes it informed undersampling.
Correct — majority points voted as the other class by their neighbors have either strayed into minority territory or are noise, so removing them cleans the boundary.
ENN relies on neighbor agreement, not geometric center/edge position, so this criterion is wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删除被自己 k 近邻多数投票错分的样本（这里针对多数类），清理噪声与边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ENN (Edited Nearest Neighbors) removes samples misclassified by their k-nearest-neighbor majority vote (here in the majority), cleaning noise and the boundary.

scenario: 两类在边界重叠严重的中重度不平衡数据。你既想补足少数类、又想让重叠的边界更清晰，愿意接受较高的预处理计算量。
scenario_en: Moderately-to-heavily imbalanced data with heavy boundary overlap. You want to both boost the minority and sharpen the overlapping boundary, accepting higher preprocessing cost.
q: 该用哪种组合采样策略？
q_en: Which combined sampling strategy fits?
why: 先用 SMOTE 在少数类间插值补量、平衡类别，再用 Tomek links 删掉边界上互为最近邻的混淆对，把重叠边界擦清晰。代价是计算更重、prior 被改，部署前要重新校准。
why_en: Use SMOTE + Tomek links: SMOTE balances by interpolation, then Tomek removes overlapping opposite-class nearest-neighbor pairs to sharpen the boundary.
tradeoff: SMOTE+Tomek(平衡+擦边界，适合重叠类) vs 纯 SMOTE(补量但不清边界) vs 纯欠采样(丢边界信息)
options: 只做随机欠采样：直接把多数类砍到和少数类一样多，最省事
SMOTE + Tomek links：先插值平衡，再删边界混淆对
只做随机过采样：复制少数类样本到平衡为止，完全不动重叠边界
什么都不做，直接用类别加权损失调高少数类惩罚，边界重叠留给模型自己学
options_en: Just random undersampling: cut the majority down to the minority count — simplest.
SMOTE + Tomek links: interpolate to balance first, then delete the boundary confusion pairs.
Just random oversampling: duplicate minority samples until balanced and leave the overlapping boundary alone.
Do nothing — just raise the minority class's loss weight and let the model learn the overlapping boundary on its own.
whenOtherWins: 如果边界并不重叠、只是单纯数量少，纯 SMOTE 或类别加权就够了，不必额外付 Tomek 的清理开销。
optionExplanations: 随机欠采样会连边界附近的多数类信息一起砍掉，重叠区反而更难学，是丢信息的省事。
对；SMOTE 补量 + Tomek 擦边界正好对上「补少数类 + 清重叠边界」两个诉求，是重叠类场景的标准组合。
纯过采样不碰边界，重叠依旧模糊，且复制副本还带来过拟合，解决不了本题的边界问题。
调高少数类惩罚确实能缓解数量不平衡，但对「边界重叠」这个几何问题无能为力，边界不会自己学清楚。
optionExplanations_en: Random undersampling cuts away majority information near the boundary too, making the overlap region harder to learn — simple but lossy.
Correct — SMOTE to add volume plus Tomek to sharpen the boundary maps exactly onto 'boost minority + clean overlap,' the standard combo for overlapping classes.
Pure oversampling never touches the boundary, so overlap stays blurred and duplicated copies add overfitting, missing the boundary problem.
Raising the minority weight does ease the count imbalance, but it cannot fix the geometric overlap problem — the boundary won't sharpen itself.

termDefinitions.meaning: 组合采样：先 SMOTE 过采样平衡，再用 Tomek links 删边界混淆对，兼顾平衡与边界清晰。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SMOTE + Tomek links is a combined method: SMOTE oversamples to balance, then Tomek removes boundary confusion pairs, balancing and sharpening at once.

scenario: 你用 SMOTE 把训练集从 0.5% 正例重采样到 50/50 训了模型，线上却发现模型输出的「欺诈概率 0.8」远高于真实欺诈率，下游按概率设的成本阈值全失灵。
scenario_en: You SMOTE the training set from 0.5% positives to 50/50, train, and in production the model's '0.8 fraud probability' far exceeds the true fraud rate, breaking downstream probability-based cost thresholds.
q: 根因是什么，部署前该补哪一步？
q_en: What is the root cause, and which step must you add before deploy?
why: 重采样把训练时的类别 prior 从 0.5% 抬到 50%，模型输出的概率不再对应真实发生率——校准被破坏。部署前要在保留真实 prior 的验证集上做后验校准。
why_en: SMOTE/ADASYN shift the training prior, so predicted probabilities no longer match true rates; recalibrate with Platt scaling or isotonic regression before deploy.
options: 根因是模型欠拟合，解决办法是再多训几个 epoch 直到输出概率下降
SMOTE 抬高训练 prior 破坏校准；部署前在真实 prior 上重新校准
根因是特征漂移，解决办法是重新采集特征并监控输入分布，跟训练时的重采样完全无关
根因是阈值设错，把决策阈值从 0.5 改到 0.8 即可，不需要做任何校准
options_en: The root cause is underfitting; train a few more epochs until the predicted probabilities come down.
SMOTE raised the training prior and broke calibration; recalibrate on the true prior before deploy.
The root cause is feature drift; re-collect the features and monitor the input distribution — it has nothing to do with the training-time resampling.
The root cause is a wrong threshold; move the decision threshold from 0.5 to 0.8 and skip calibration entirely.
optionExplanations: 多训 epoch 不改 prior 被抬高这个系统性偏移，概率照样偏高，欠拟合不是这里的病因。
对；后验校准（Platt scaling / isotonic regression）在自然分布的验证集上重拟合概率映射，让按概率算成本的下游决策重新可信。
问题出在训练分布被人为改了、不是线上特征漂移，方向找错了。
调阈值能让分类工作，但概率本身仍不可信，任何依赖概率数值的下游成本决策照样失灵。
optionExplanations_en: More epochs do not undo the systematic prior shift, so probabilities stay inflated; underfitting is not the cause here.

Correct — post-hoc calibration (Platt scaling or isotonic regression) refits the probability mapping on a naturally distributed validation set, making cost decisions that read probabilities trustworthy again.
The problem is the artificially changed training distribution, not production feature drift — wrong direction.
Tuning the threshold makes classification work, but the probabilities remain untrustworthy, so any downstream cost decision that reads the probability value still breaks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后验校准法：在模型分数上拟合一个 sigmoid，把分数映射回校准概率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Platt scaling is post-hoc calibration that fits a sigmoid on model scores to map them back to calibrated probabilities.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后验校准法：拟合一个单调非降函数把分数映射回真实概率，比 Platt 更灵活但需更多数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Isotonic regression is post-hoc calibration fitting a monotonic non-decreasing function from scores to true probabilities, more flexible than Platt but data-hungry.

scenario: 两塔检索模型（用户塔 + 物品塔）：查询「best running shoes」时随机采的负例大多是「中世纪建筑」这类毫不相关的文档，模型轻松区分，训练几步就停滞，损失降不下去。
scenario_en: A two-tower retrieval model (user tower + item tower): for 'best running shoes' the random negatives are mostly irrelevant like 'medieval architecture,' trivially separable, and training plateaus after a few steps.
q: 该怎么解决负例太简单导致的训练停滞？
q_en: How do you fix the training plateau caused by trivial negatives?
why: 问题不是正例稀有，而是随机负例太好区分、梯度≈0 导致训练停滞；要挖 hard negatives——嵌入空间里贴近正例但确实不相关的负例。代价是挖太狠会误伤 false negative。
why_en: In retrieval the issue is trivial negatives with vanishing gradients, so mine hard negatives close to positives in embedding space to force fine-grained distinctions.
tradeoff: hard negatives(逼细粒度区分、有信息) vs 随机 easy negatives(梯度消失、训练停滞)
diagram:
flowchart LR Q["query: running shoes"] --> E["easy neg: 中世纪建筑
梯度≈0 停滞"] Q --> H["hard neg: hiking boots
贴近正例、强梯度"] H --> M["逼模型学细粒度区分"]
options: 增大 batch size，让模型每步看到更多随机负例，靠数量突破停滞
hard negative mining：挑嵌入里贴近正例但确实不相关的难负例
把所有简单负例复制多份加进训练集，用重复次数提高负例权重
降低学习率并延长训练，让模型在简单负例上收敛得更稳、梯度震荡更小，减少无意义的抖动
options_en: Increase batch size so each step sees more random negatives, breaking the plateau by volume.
Hard negative mining: pick negatives close to positives in embedding space yet genuinely irrelevant.
Duplicate every easy negative several times into the training set, raising negative weight by repetition.
Lower the learning rate and train longer so the model converges more stably with less gradient oscillation on the easy negatives.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务本就靠粗粒度区分即可（类别差异极大、无需细分），随机负例就够，硬挖难负例反而增加 false-negative 风险。
optionExplanations: 更多随机负例还是简单负例，梯度依旧接近零，加量不解决「信息量为零」的根本问题。
对；难负例贴近正例才有非零梯度，逼模型分清「跑鞋 vs 徒步靴」这类细差，正是突破停滞的关键。
复制简单负例只是把零信息样本重复喂，权重再高也带不来梯度，停滞照旧。
降学习率改变的是步长、不改简单负例梯度≈0 的事实，训得再久也学不到新东西。
optionExplanations_en: More random negatives are still easy, gradients stay near zero, and volume does not fix the zero-information root cause.
Correct — hard negatives near positives carry nonzero gradient, forcing the model to separate 'running shoes vs hiking boots' fine distinctions, the key to breaking the plateau.
Duplicating easy negatives just repeats zero-information samples; higher weight brings no gradient and the plateau persists.
Lowering the learning rate changes step size, not the fact that easy-negative gradients are near zero, so longer training learns nothing new.

termDefinitions.meaning: 查询和物品各用一个编码塔映成向量，用向量相似度做检索，训练靠正负例对比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-tower model encodes query and item with separate towers into vectors and retrieves by vector similarity, trained by contrasting positives and negatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在嵌入空间贴近正例但实际不相关的负例，梯度大、逼模型做细粒度区分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hard negative is close to the positive in embedding space but actually irrelevant, giving strong gradient and forcing fine-grained distinctions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 样本太易区分时损失梯度趋近于零，模型学不到东西、训练停滞。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A vanishing gradient is when trivially separable samples give near-zero loss gradient, so the model stops learning and training plateaus.

q: 把「用当前模型挖难负例」的反馈回路排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the feedback loop for mining hard negatives with the current model:
steps: 用当前模型对 query 检索出 top-k 候选
从 top-k 里过滤掉已知的正例
保留排名靠前但确认为负的候选
把这些高排名负例作为下一批训练的难负例
why: 回路：当前模型检索 top-k → 过滤掉已知正例（避免误当负例）→ 留下排名高却是负的候选（模型自以为相关但其实不相关）→ 作为下一批难负例。用模型自身的错误来喂它最该纠正的样本，是随模型进化的闭环。
why_en: Retrieve top-k with the current model, filter known positives, keep high-ranked confirmed negatives, and feed them as the next batch's hard negatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对一个 query 返回相似度最高的 k 个候选，是检索系统的基本操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-k retrieval returns the k highest-similarity candidates for a query, the basic retrieval operation.

termDefinitions.term: hard negative mining / 难负例挖掘
termDefinitions.meaning: 用当前模型找出它排得高却其实是负的样本，作为下一轮训练的强信号负例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hard negative mining uses the current model to find samples it ranks high but are actually negative, feeding them as strong-signal negatives next round.

scenario: 你把难负例挖得很激进，只要模型排名高就当负例推开。结果里混进了一些其实相关、只是没被标注为正例的物品（false negatives），检索质量反而下降。
scenario_en: You mine hard negatives aggressively, treating anything high-ranked as a negative to push away. Some are actually relevant items merely unlabeled as positive (false negatives), and retrieval quality drops.
q: 这个失效模式是什么，怎么缓解？
q_en: What is this failure mode, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 挖得太狠会把 false negatives（相关但未标注的正例）当成难负例推开，等于教模型「相关的东西不相关」。缓解用 semi-hard negatives：够难但明确不相关。
why_en: Over-aggressive mining treats false negatives (relevant but unlabeled) as hard negatives and pushes them away, so use semi-hard negatives that are challenging yet clearly irrelevant.
options: 失效模式是负例太少；缓解方法是把阈值放宽、挖更多更贴近正例的负例
失效模式是把漏标正例当难负例推开；缓解改用 semi-hard 负例
失效模式是训练收敛太慢；缓解方法是只用随机负例、彻底放弃难负例
没有失效模式，越贴近正例的负例永远越好，质量下降一定是别的原因
options_en: The failure mode is too few negatives; loosen the threshold and mine more negatives that sit closer to the positives.
The failure mode is pushing unlabeled positives away as hard negatives; switch to semi-hard negatives.
The failure mode is slow convergence; mitigate by using only random negatives and abandoning hard ones entirely.
There is no failure mode — negatives closer to positives are always better, so the drop must come from elsewhere.
optionExplanations: 反了：挖更贴近的负例只会撞上更多漏标正例，加剧 false-negative 问题，不是缓解。
对；贴太近的「负例」很可能是没标的正例，推开它=教模型犯错；semi-hard 在「够难」和「确定是负」之间取平衡。
回到纯随机负例会重新陷入梯度消失、训练停滞，是把难负例的好处也一起扔了。
越贴近未必越好——贴到与正例难分时就有 false-negative 风险，这正是需要 semi-hard 的原因。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: mining closer negatives hits more unlabeled positives, worsening the false-negative problem, not mitigating it.
Correct — too-close 'negatives' are likely unlabeled positives, so pushing them away teaches errors; semi-hard balances 'hard enough' against 'certainly negative.'
Reverting to pure random negatives reinstates vanishing gradients and plateaus, throwing away the benefit of hard negatives.
Closer is not always better — once it is hard to tell from the positive, false-negative risk appears, which is exactly why semi-hard exists.

termDefinitions.meaning: 实际相关但未被标注为正例的物品，被误当难负例推开会损害检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false negative here is a relevant but unlabeled item wrongly used as a hard negative, hurting retrieval when pushed away.

termDefinitions.meaning: 有挑战性但明确不相关的负例，避开贴太近、可能是漏标正例的样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A semi-hard negative is challenging yet clearly irrelevant, avoiding too-close samples that may be unlabeled positives.

scenario: 两塔检索训练要海量负例，但为每个 query 单独检索、构造难负例代价高。你想要一个可扩展、几乎零额外成本的负例来源。
scenario_en: Two-tower training needs many negatives, but retrieving and constructing hard negatives per query is costly. You want a scalable, near-zero-extra-cost negative source.
q: 该用什么可扩展的负例构造方式，代价是什么？
q_en: What scalable way to build negatives fits, and at what cost?
why: in-batch negatives 拿同 batch 里别的 query 的正例当负例，一批正例被 N×N 复用、几乎零额外计算，天然可扩展。代价是难度不可控，多是简单负例、信息量低。
why_en: Use in-batch negatives: other queries' positives in the same batch serve as this query's negatives at near-zero extra cost, but their difficulty is uncontrolled.
tradeoff: in-batch negatives(可扩展、近零成本但难度不可控) vs 显式 hard mining(可控难度但每 query 要额外检索)
options: 为每个 query 都在线检索并人工确认一批难负例，追求最高负例质量
in-batch negatives：拿同 batch 里别人的正例当负例，近零成本
把整个物品库当每个 query 的负例逐一算 loss，保证覆盖全部负例
只用正例训练，靠正则化项自动产生负例的推开效果，还能省掉负例采样和难例挖掘这一整套流程
options_en: For each query, retrieve online and manually confirm a batch of hard negatives, chasing top negative quality.
In-batch negatives: reuse other queries' positives in the same batch as negatives at near-zero cost.
Compute loss against the entire item catalog as negatives for each query to guarantee full coverage.
Train on positives only and let a regularization term produce the push-away effect of negatives, skipping negative sampling and hard mining entirely.
whenOtherWins: 如果检索质量瓶颈在细粒度区分、简单 in-batch 负例已喂不动模型，就该额外做显式 hard negative mining 提难度。
optionExplanations: 逐 query 在线检索+人工确认质量高但成本极高，扩不到大规模训练，与「近零成本」诉求相反。
对；in-batch 复用 batch 内正例，N 个 query 免费得到 N×N 个负例对，可扩展是它最大的卖点，代价是难度全靠随机。
拿全库当负例计算量爆炸，根本训不动，可扩展性最差。
只用正例没有对比信号，模型会塌缩（所有东西都相似），正则化替代不了负例。
optionExplanations_en: Per-query online retrieval plus manual confirmation is high quality but extremely costly and does not scale, contradicting the 'near-zero cost' goal.
Correct — in-batch reuse gives N queries N×N free negative pairs, and scalability is its selling point, at the cost of difficulty left to chance.
Using the whole catalog as negatives explodes compute and is untrainable — the least scalable.
Positives-only lacks a contrastive signal and the model collapses (everything similar); regularization cannot substitute for negatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把同一 batch 里其他 query 的正例当作当前 query 的负例，复用样本、近零额外成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In-batch negatives reuse other queries' positives in the same batch as the current query's negatives at near-zero extra cost.

scenario: 一个 0.1% 正例的数据集，你用普通随机划分切出 train/val/test。测试集里可能一个正例都没有。
scenario_en: A dataset with 0.1% positives, split into train/val/test by ordinary random split. The test set may contain zero positives.
q: 这样划分会怎样破坏评估，正确做法是什么？
q_en: How does this break evaluation, and what is the right approach?
why: 极端稀有下随机划分可能让测试集一个正例都没有，precision/recall 直接算不出来。要用分层抽样让每个 split 保持相同类别比例，k 折则用 stratified k-fold。
why_en: A random split can leave zero positives in the test set, making precision/recall meaningless; use stratified sampling to preserve the class ratio across splits.
options: 没问题，随机划分对任何数据都公平，正例太少是数据本身的问题
随机划分可能让测试集零正例；改用分层抽样保持各 split 类别比例
应该把所有正例都放进测试集、训练集只留负例，保证测试一定有正例
先对全量数据 SMOTE 再随机划分，就能保证每个 split 都有正例
options_en: No problem — random splitting is fair on any dataset, and having few positives is just how the data is.
Random splitting can leave zero positives in test; use stratified sampling to keep the class ratio in every split.
Put every positive into the test set and leave only negatives for training, guaranteeing test has positives.
SMOTE the whole dataset first, then random-split, so every split has positives.
optionExplanations: 随机划分在稀有类下并不「公平」——它会以不小的概率给出零正例测试集，让评估彻底失效。
对；按类别分层后再抽，每个 split 的正例数可预期、指标才有统计意义，k 折同理用 stratified 版本。
把正例全塞测试集则训练集没有正例可学，模型根本训不出来，因噎废食。
先 SMOTE 再划分会把合成正例泄漏进测试集，虚高 recall、掩盖真实 precision，这是明确禁止的做法。
optionExplanations_en: Random splitting is not 'fair' under rarity — with non-trivial probability it yields a zero-positive test set that nullifies evaluation.
Correct — stratifying by class before sampling makes the positive count in each split predictable so the metrics carry statistical meaning; k-fold uses the stratified variant for the same reason.
Putting all positives in test leaves none for training, so the model cannot learn at all — self-defeating.
SMOTE-then-split leaks synthetic positives into test, inflating recall and masking true precision — an explicitly forbidden practice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按类别比例分层后再抽样划分，使 train/val/test 保持相同的类别分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stratified sampling stratifies by class before drawing so train/val/test keep the same class distribution.

scenario: 0.05% 欺诈数据。你对训练集做了 SMOTE，验证集上召回很漂亮，但上线后误报（false positive）是预期的 10 倍。
scenario_en: 0.05% fraud data. You SMOTE the training set, validation recall looks great, but production false positives are 10x expected.
q: 最可能的根因是什么？
q_en: What is the most likely root cause?
why: 验证集也被一起重采样了：合成正例混进验证集撑高召回，人为的 50/50 掩盖了自然 prior 下的低 precision。上线回到 0.05% 后，同一判别面就爆出 10 倍误报。
why_en: The validation set was also resampled, so synthetic positives inflated recall and hid the poor precision at the natural prior, which erupts as 10x false positives in production.
options: 模型欠拟合、训练轮数不够，多训几轮就能降低线上误报
验证集也被 SMOTE 重采样，虚高召回、掩盖真实 precision
线上出现了全新的欺诈模式，与验证集是否重采样无关
特征在训练和服务间发生了漂移，属于 training-serving skew
options_en: The model underfits with too few epochs; a few more rounds of training will cut production false positives.
The validation set was resampled by SMOTE too, inflating recall and hiding the real precision.
A brand-new fraud pattern showed up in production, unrelated to whether validation was resampled.
Features drifted between training and serving — a training-serving skew issue.
optionExplanations: 欠拟合解释不了「验证很好、线上很差」的落差；问题在评估分布被污染，不在训练不足。
对；合成正例漏进验证集让 recall 虚高，而 50/50 评估看不见真实 prior 下的高误报，回到 0.05% 就现形为 10 倍 FP。
全新欺诈模式无法解释验证集和线上的系统性偏差；这里指标错位的来源是评估集被重采样。
特征漂移会让训练和服务的特征值不一致，但本例是评估分布被人为改了，不是特征计算不一致。
optionExplanations_en: Underfitting cannot explain the 'great validation, poor production' gap; the problem is a contaminated evaluation distribution, not insufficient training.
Correct — synthetic positives leaking into validation inflate recall, and 50/50 evaluation hides the high false-positive rate at the true prior, which erupts as 10x FP back at 0.05%.
A new fraud pattern cannot explain the systematic validation-vs-production discrepancy; the metric mismatch comes from a resampled eval set.
Feature drift makes training and serving feature values diverge, but here the evaluation distribution was artificially changed, not the feature computation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 SMOTE 等重采样用到验证/测试集，合成样本泄漏进评估，虚高召回、掩盖真实 precision。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Resampling leakage applies SMOTE to validation/test, leaking synthetic samples into evaluation and inflating recall while hiding true precision.

codeSample:
# 铁律：先分层划分，只在训练折内重采样
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=0)  # val 保住 0.05% prior
X_tr, y_tr = SMOTE(random_state=0).fit_resample(X_tr, y_tr)  # 只碰训练折
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
# 在未重采样的 val 上看 precision，才等于线上会看到的数字
print(precision_score(y_val, model.predict(X_val)))

scenario: 严重不平衡（正例 <1%）下评估分类器，你在 ROC-AUC 和 PR 曲线之间选一个作为主指标。
scenario_en: Evaluating a classifier under severe imbalance (positives <1%), you pick between ROC-AUC and the PR curve as the primary metric.
q: 为什么在严重不平衡下 PR 曲线优于 ROC-AUC？
q_en: Why is the PR curve preferred over ROC-AUC under severe imbalance?
why: ROC 的 FPR = FP/(FP+TN)，海量真负例把分母撑大，FPR 显得极小、TPR 被抬得虚高，ROC-AUC 看着很乐观。PR 曲线不含 TN，如实反映稀有正例抓到多少、误报多严重。
why_en: ROC's FPR has a huge true-negative denominator that keeps FPR tiny and TPR inflated, looking optimistic, while the PR curve excludes TN and honestly reflects rare-positive performance.
tradeoff: PR 曲线(只看正例相关量、如实) vs ROC-AUC(含海量 TN、偏斜下虚高乐观)
options: PR 曲线计算更快，ROC-AUC 太慢，所以偏斜下选 PR
ROC 的 FPR 分母含海量真负例、TPR 虚高；PR 不含 TN 更如实
ROC-AUC 在任何情况下都不可用，PR 曲线在均衡数据上也永远更好
两者完全等价，只是坐标轴换了名字，偏斜下随便选一个都行，反正曲线下面积的排序结论一致
options_en: The PR curve computes faster and ROC-AUC is too slow, so pick PR under skew.
ROC's FPR denominator is full of true negatives so TPR looks inflated; PR excludes TN and stays honest.
ROC-AUC is unusable in any situation, and the PR curve is always better even on balanced data.
They are completely equivalent, just renamed axes, so under skew you can pick either one — the AUC ranking conclusion stays the same regardless.
optionExplanations: 选择依据是指标含义、不是计算速度，PR 优于 ROC 与快慢无关。
对；关键在 ROC 把 TN 塞进 FPR 分母，偏斜下 FPR 被稀释、AUC 虚高；PR 无 TN，直击稀有正例的抓取与误报。
太绝对：类别均衡时 ROC-AUC 是合理且常用的指标，PR 不是永远更好。
两者信息侧重不同（PR 无 TN、ROC 含 TN），偏斜下不仅数值不同、连排序结论都会分叉，绝非等价换名。
optionExplanations_en: The choice is about metric meaning, not compute speed; PR over ROC has nothing to do with which is faster.
Correct — the key is that ROC puts TN in the FPR denominator, so under skew FPR is diluted and AUC inflated; PR has no TN and hits rare-positive capture and false alarms directly.
Too absolute: on balanced data ROC-AUC is a reasonable, common metric, and PR is not always better.
They emphasize different information (PR excludes TN, ROC includes it); under skew not just the values but the ranking conclusions diverge — not equivalent renaming.

termDefinitions.fullName: Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve
termDefinitions.meaning: TPR 对 FPR 曲线下的面积；FPR 含真负例，偏斜下会显得过于乐观。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ROC-AUC is the area under the TPR-vs-FPR curve; its FPR includes true negatives, looking overly optimistic under skew.

termDefinitions.meaning: FPR=FP/(FP+TN) 假正率；TPR=TP/(TP+FN) 真正率(=recall)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FPR = FP/(FP+TN) is the false-positive rate; TPR = TP/(TP+FN) is the true-positive rate (recall).

scenario: 极稀有正例数据，你想做 k 折交叉验证来减小单次划分带来的评估方差。
scenario_en: Very rare-positive data; you want k-fold cross-validation to cut the evaluation variance of a single split.
q: 该用普通 k 折还是 stratified k-fold，为什么？
q_en: Plain k-fold or stratified k-fold, and why?
why: stratified k-fold 让每折都保持整体类别比例，避免某折正例过少甚至为零；再对各折的 P/R 取平均，降低单次划分带来的方差。
why_en: Use stratified k-fold so every fold keeps the overall class ratio, avoiding folds with too few or zero positives, and average per-fold metrics to cut variance.
options: 普通 k 折即可，随机分折在稀有类下也能保证每折都有足够正例数
stratified k-fold：每折保持整体类别比例并平均 P/R
只做一次划分就够了，交叉验证在不平衡数据下没有意义，反正正例太少怎么分都不准
把正例全放进一个折、负例放进其余各折，再做 k 折
options_en: Plain k-fold is fine; random folding still guarantees enough positives in every fold under rarity.
Stratified k-fold: keep the overall class ratio in each fold and average the per-fold P/R.
A single split is enough — cross-validation is meaningless on imbalanced data since there are too few positives to split accurately anyway.
Put all positives into one fold and the negatives into the remaining folds, then run k-fold.
optionExplanations: 普通 k 折随机分，稀有类下完全可能有折的正例极少或为零，那一折的 P/R 就不可信。
对；stratified 保证每折同比例、都有正例，平均多折又压掉单次划分的运气成分，是稀有类评估的标准做法。
恰恰相反，不平衡下更需要交叉验证来降低单次划分的高方差，一次划分反而最不稳。
把正例集中到一折会让其余折没有正例、无法评估，也破坏了每折的代表性。
optionExplanations_en: Plain k-fold splits randomly, so under rarity a fold can easily have very few or zero positives, making that fold's P/R untrustworthy.
Correct — stratified guarantees each fold has the same ratio and positives, and averaging folds cancels single-split luck — the standard for rare-class evaluation.
The opposite: imbalance makes cross-validation more necessary to reduce single-split variance, and one split is the least stable.
Concentrating positives in one fold leaves the others with none to evaluate and breaks each fold's representativeness.

termDefinitions.term: stratified k-fold / 分层 k 折
termDefinitions.meaning: 交叉验证时每折都保持整体的类别比例，保证稀有类在每折都有代表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stratified k-fold keeps the overall class ratio in every fold, ensuring the rare class is represented in each.

termDefinitions.term: bootstrapped CI / 自助置信区间
termDefinitions.meaning: 对指标重复有放回抽样估计其置信区间，量化稀有类评估的不确定性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bootstrapped CI resamples with replacement to estimate a metric's confidence interval, quantifying rare-class evaluation uncertainty.

scenario: 客户流失预测，正负比约 10:1（中度不平衡），是常规二分类表格任务，没有极端稀有也不是检索问题。
scenario_en: Churn prediction with about 10:1 positive-negative ratio (moderate imbalance), a standard binary tabular task — neither extreme rarity nor a retrieval problem.
q: 中度不平衡该用什么处理方案？
q_en: For moderate imbalance, which handling fits?
why: 中度不平衡（~10:1）用 SMOTE 或类别加权损失就够，属于「轻量处理 + 记得校准」档位。不必上 SMOTE+Tomek、bootstrapped CI 这类严重不平衡才配的重武器。
why_en: Moderate ~10:1 imbalance is handled by SMOTE or class-weighted loss, mentioning calibration, without the heavier machinery reserved for severe imbalance.
tradeoff: SMOTE/类别加权(中度够用、轻量) vs SMOTE+Tomek+bootstrap CI(严重不平衡才需要、更重)
options: 上难负例挖掘 + in-batch negatives，把它当检索问题处理
SMOTE 或类别加权损失即可，并记得重采样后重新校准概率
必须 SMOTE+Tomek + 分层划分 + PR 曲线 + bootstrapped CI 全套重武器
什么都不用做，10:1 用普通交叉熵直接训就行
options_en: Apply hard negative mining + in-batch negatives, treating it as a retrieval problem.
SMOTE or a class-weighted loss suffices, remembering to recalibrate probabilities after resampling.
You must use the full heavy kit: SMOTE+Tomek + stratified splits + PR curves + bootstrapped CIs.
Do nothing — train 10:1 straight with plain cross-entropy.
whenOtherWins: 如果不平衡升级到严重档（如欺诈 <1%、医疗异常），才该上 SMOTE+Tomek、分层划分和 bootstrapped CI；检索/排序任务才用难负例挖掘。
optionExplanations: 难负例挖掘是检索/排序的工具，churn 是普通二分类、没有嵌入检索场景，用错了工具。
对；10:1 属中度，SMOTE 或类别加权足以纠偏，成本低；唯一别忘的是重采样改了 prior、要重新校准。
全套重武器是给严重不平衡准备的，10:1 上用属于过度工程，徒增复杂度。
10:1 直接用交叉熵，多数类仍会主导、少数类召回偏低，「什么都不做」不达标。
optionExplanations_en: Hard negative mining is a retrieval/ranking tool; churn is plain binary classification with no embedding-retrieval scenario, so it is the wrong tool.
Correct — 10:1 is moderate, SMOTE or class weighting corrects the skew cheaply, and the one thing to remember is recalibration since resampling changed the prior.
The full heavy kit is for severe imbalance; using it at 10:1 is over-engineering that adds needless complexity.
Training 10:1 straight lets the majority dominate and minority recall stay low, so 'do nothing' falls short.

termDefinitions.term: class-weighted loss / 类别加权损失
termDefinitions.meaning: 在损失里给少数类样本更大权重，无需重采样即可抵消数量不平衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A class-weighted loss gives minority samples larger weight in the loss, offsetting count imbalance without resampling.

scenario: 医疗异常检测，正例极稀有（远低于 1%），漏检代价极高，两类在边界还有重叠。要给出一套严谨、能上报的评估与训练方案。
scenario_en: Medical anomaly detection with extremely rare positives (well below 1%), very high miss cost, and boundary overlap. You need a rigorous, reportable training and evaluation plan.
q: 严重不平衡该配哪一整套方案？
q_en: For severe imbalance, which full plan fits?
why: 严重不平衡要上重武器：SMOTE+Tomek 补少数类并擦重叠边界、分层划分保证评估集有正例、报 PR 曲线而非 ROC、bootstrapped CI 给极稀有指标带上区间。
why_en: Severe imbalance needs the heavy kit: SMOTE+Tomek for training, stratified splits, PR curves, and bootstrapped CIs on the metrics.
tradeoff: SMOTE+Tomek+分层+PR+bootstrap CI(严重不平衡的严谨评估) vs 中度的 SMOTE+校准(不够稳)
options: 只用类别加权损失训练，报告准确率即可，不需要重采样或分层划分，反正权重已经补偿了不平衡
SMOTE+Tomek + 分层划分 + PR 曲线 + bootstrap CI
把它当检索问题，用 in-batch negatives 和难负例挖掘处理
对 val/test 也做 SMOTE 让评估集正例更多，指标看起来更好更稳
options_en: Just train with a class-weighted loss and report accuracy — no resampling or stratified splitting needed, since the weighting already compensates for the imbalance.
SMOTE+Tomek plus stratified splits, PR curves, and bootstrap CIs.
Treat it as retrieval and handle it with in-batch negatives and hard negative mining.
SMOTE the val/test sets too so the eval sets hold more positives and the metrics look better and steadier.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是中度不平衡（~10:1）且边界不重叠，轻量的 SMOTE 或类别加权就够，无需上 Tomek 和 bootstrapped CI 这套重流程。
optionExplanations: 类别加权确实是训练手段之一，但它补偿的是损失函数、不是评估指标——用准确率报告严重不平衡结果照样被 prior 灌水，评估这一环就废了。
对；补量+擦边界+分层评估+PR+CI 一整套，既处理数量与重叠，又让极稀有下的指标带上可信区间，是严重档的标准答案。
医疗异常是分类不是检索，没有查询-物品嵌入场景，难负例挖掘用错了范式。
对 val/test 重采样是明确铁律禁止的，会虚高 recall、掩盖真实 precision，上线必翻车。
optionExplanations_en: Class weighting is a legitimate training tactic, but it compensates the loss function, not the evaluation metric — reporting severe-imbalance results with accuracy still lets the prior inflate it, breaking the evaluation step.
Correct — add volume, sharpen the boundary, stratify, report PR, and put CIs on rare metrics: the full kit handles count and overlap while giving trustworthy intervals — the severe-tier standard.
Medical anomaly is classification, not retrieval, with no query-item embedding scenario, so hard negative mining is the wrong paradigm.
Resampling val/test is explicitly forbidden — it inflates recall and hides true precision, guaranteeing a production blowup.

termDefinitions.meaning: 正例远低于 1%（欺诈、医疗异常），需重采样+清边界+分层评估+PR/CI 全套处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Severe imbalance is positives well under 1% (fraud, medical anomaly), needing resampling, boundary cleanup, stratified evaluation, and PR/CIs.

q: 把严重不平衡（欺诈）项目的处理流水线排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the pipeline for a severe-imbalance (fraud) project correctly:
steps: 先分层划分 train/val/test，保证每个 split 保留自然 prior 的正例
只在训练折内做 SMOTE+Tomek 重采样，val/test 保持自然 prior
训练后在保留真实 prior 的验证集上重新校准概率
用 PR 曲线 + bootstrapped CI 报告，并监控上线后有效比例的漂移
why: 顺序是关键：先分层划分（必须在重采样之前，否则合成样本泄漏进评估）→ 只在训练折重采样 → 在自然 prior 上重校准 → 用 PR+CI 报告并监控比例漂移。
why_en: Split stratified first (before any resampling to avoid leakage), resample only training folds, recalibrate on the true prior, then report with PR+CI and monitor drift.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  S["分层划分"] --> R["仅训练折 SMOTE+Tomek"]
  R --> C["真实 prior 上重校准"]
  C --> E["PR+CI 报告 + 监控漂移"]

termDefinitions.term: point of resampling / 重采样时点
termDefinitions.meaning: 重采样必须在划分之后、且只作用于训练折，避免合成样本泄漏进 val/test。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Resampling must come after splitting and touch only training folds, avoiding synthetic-sample leakage into val/test.

scenario: 不平衡数据评估有几条不可违反的铁律，违反了要么泄漏、要么指标虚高。
scenario_en: A few unbreakable rules govern evaluating imbalanced data; break them and you get leakage or inflated metrics.
q: 补全不平衡评估的三条铁律：
q_en: Fill in the three evaluation rules for imbalance:
text: ① 绝不对 {{验证/测试}} 集做 SMOTE/重采样，只在 {{训练}} 折内重采样；② 重采样训练后要重新 {{校准}} 概率；③ 严重偏斜下报告 {{PR}} 曲线而非 ROC-AUC。
text_en: 1) Never SMOTE/resample the {{validation/test}} set — resample only within {{training}} folds; 2) after resampled training, {{recalibrate}} the probabilities; 3) under severe skew report {{PR}} curves, not ROC-AUC.
why: 这三条对应三个坑：重采样泄漏进评估会虚高 recall；重采样改了 prior 不校准则概率不可信；ROC 含海量 TN 在偏斜下过于乐观。记住「训练内重采样、评估外守自然 prior、报告用 PR」这条主线。
why_en: Resample only inside training, keep the natural prior in evaluation, recalibrate after, and report PR under skew.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据里真实的类别比例（如欺诈 0.05%），评估集必须保持它才反映真实表现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The natural prior is the real class ratio in data (e.g. 0.05% fraud); evaluation must keep it to reflect true performance.

scenario: 一个欺诈模型上线时按 0.5% 欺诈率训练和校准，几个月后攻击者手法改变，实际欺诈率悄悄升到 2%，模型的误报和漏报都开始异常。
scenario_en: A fraud model trained and calibrated at 0.5% fraud goes live; months later attacker tactics change and the real fraud rate creeps to 2%, and both false positives and misses start misbehaving.
q: 该怎么应对这种有效类别比例的漂移？
q_en: How do you handle this shift in the effective class ratio?
why: 有效正例比例变了，原来的校准和阈值一起失效：概率刻度对不上新 prior。要持续监控线上比例，检测到漂移就用新分布重新校准、必要时重训调阈值。
why_en: The effective positive rate changed, breaking the old calibration and thresholds, so monitor the live ratio, recalibrate on the new distribution, and retrain/retune when drift is detected.
options: 无需处理，模型一旦训好就对任何比例的欺诈都稳健
监控线上正例比例，漂移后用新分布重新校准并按需重训调阈值
把决策阈值永久调到 0.5 就能自动适应任何比例变化
对历史训练数据再做一次更强的 SMOTE 就能修复线上漂移
options_en: No action needed — once trained, the model is robust to any fraud rate.
Monitor the live positive rate, and once drift shows up recalibrate on the new distribution, retraining and retuning thresholds as needed.
Permanently set the decision threshold to 0.5 and it auto-adapts to any ratio change.
Run a stronger SMOTE on the historical training data again to fix the production drift.
optionExplanations: 模型的校准和阈值都绑定训练时的 prior，prior 一变就不再稳健，「无需处理」是错的。
对；prior 漂移使概率刻度和阈值失效，必须靠监控发现、用新分布重校准和调阈值来跟上，这是持续运维项。
固定阈值 0.5 既不适应新 prior，也不修校准，比例一变误报漏报照样失衡。
对历史数据再 SMOTE 改的是旧训练分布，跟线上新 prior 无关，修不了漂移。
optionExplanations_en: The model's calibration and threshold are tied to the training prior, so a shifted prior breaks robustness — 'no action' is wrong.

Correct — prior drift invalidates the probability scale and threshold, so you must detect it by monitoring and keep up via recalibration and threshold tuning on the new distribution — an ongoing operational task.
A fixed 0.5 threshold neither adapts to the new prior nor fixes calibration, so FP/FN stay imbalanced when the ratio shifts.
Re-SMOTEing historical data changes the old training distribution, unrelated to the new production prior, so it cannot fix the drift.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上类别比例随时间偏离训练时的比例，使原校准和阈值失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prior shift is the production class ratio drifting from the training ratio, invalidating the original calibration and threshold.

scenario: 一个亿级样本的点击数据，负例（未点击）占绝大多数且高度冗余，训练又慢又贵。你想在不太损失信息的前提下缩小训练集。
scenario_en: Billion-scale click data where negatives (no-click) dominate and are highly redundant, making training slow and costly. You want to shrink the training set without losing much information.
q: 该用哪种采样，代价与风险是什么？
q_en: Which sampling fits, and what are its cost and risk?
why: 大而冗余的多数类适合随机欠采样：直接丢掉一部分多数类，训练更快更省，且因为多数类冗余、丢一些信息损失有限。风险是可能连边界附近有信息的多数类也一起丢掉——所以对边界敏感时改用 Tomek/ENN 这类有信息欠采样，只删该删的。
why_en: A large redundant majority suits random undersampling — drop some majority for faster, cheaper training with limited loss, but it may discard informative near-boundary majority points.
tradeoff: 随机欠采样(快、省、冗余下损失小 vs 可能丢边界信息) — 边界敏感则用 Tomek/ENN 有信息欠采样
options: SMOTE 过采样少数类到十亿级，让两类都达到十亿规模
随机欠采样多数类：丢冗余负例省算力，风险是误丢边界样本
复制少数类到和多数类一样多，把训练集撑得更大更慢
什么都不做，直接在十亿级全量数据上训练以保留所有信息
options_en: SMOTE the minority up to billion scale so both classes reach a billion samples.
Randomly undersample the majority: dropping redundant negatives saves compute, at the risk of losing informative boundary points.
Duplicate the minority up to the majority count, making the training set even bigger and slower.
Do nothing and train straight on the full billion-scale data so that no information is lost.
whenOtherWins: 如果多数类不冗余、边界附近样本很关键（如医疗），随机欠采样丢信息太多，应改用类别加权或有信息欠采样（Tomek/ENN）。
optionExplanations: 把少数类 SMOTE 到十亿是反向操作，训练集更大、更慢更贵，与「缩小训练集」的诉求完全相反。
对；多数类既大又冗余，随机欠采样正好用最低成本缩量、提速；只要留意别把边界处有信息的负例也丢了。
复制少数类会让训练集更大、更慢，且复制副本带来过拟合，解决不了「又慢又贵」。
十亿全量训练正是当前又慢又贵的原因，「什么都不做」没有回应题目诉求。
optionExplanations_en: SMOTEing the minority to a billion is the reverse move, making the set larger, slower, and costlier — opposite to 'shrink the training set.'
Correct — the majority is large and redundant, so random undersampling shrinks and speeds it cheaply; just watch not to drop informative near-boundary negatives.
Duplicating the minority makes the set larger and slower, and copies add overfitting, not solving 'slow and costly.'
Full billion-scale training is exactly what makes it slow and costly now, so 'do nothing' does not address the ask.

termDefinitions.meaning: 随机丢弃部分多数类样本以平衡类别、加速训练，冗余多数类时信息损失小。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Random undersampling randomly drops majority samples to balance classes and speed training, with limited loss when the majority is redundant.

scenario: 两塔检索训练中，你发现最难的难负例里有相当比例其实是漏标的相关项（false negatives），把它们推开正在损害线上相关性。
scenario_en: In two-tower training you find a sizeable share of the hardest negatives are actually unlabeled relevant items (false negatives), and pushing them away is hurting production relevance.
q: 该怎么调整负例选择策略？
q_en: How should you adjust the negative-selection strategy?
why: 从最难负例退一步用 semi-hard negatives：够难能给梯度，但明确不相关、不太可能是漏标正例。难度谱系 random → semi-hard → hard，false-negative 风险随难度上升。
why_en: Step back from the hardest negatives to semi-hard ones — challenging enough to give gradient yet clearly irrelevant — to keep signal while avoiding pushing away false negatives.
tradeoff: semi-hard(够难有梯度 + 明确不相关，避开漏标正例) vs 最难 hard(信号强但 false-negative 风险高)
options: 继续挖更难的负例，越贴近正例越好，false negatives 不用管
退到 semi-hard negatives：够难能给梯度但明确不相关
改用纯随机负例，彻底放弃难负例来消除 false negatives
把所有高排名候选都直接标成正例，反正它们看起来相关
options_en: Keep mining harder negatives, the closer to positives the better, and ignore false negatives.
Step back to semi-hard negatives: hard enough to give gradient yet clearly irrelevant.
Switch to pure random negatives, abandoning hard negatives entirely to eliminate false negatives.
Just label every high-ranked candidate as a positive, since they all look relevant anyway.
whenOtherWins: 如果标注非常干净、漏标正例极少，直接用最难的 hard negatives 信号更强、收敛更快，不必退到 semi-hard。
optionExplanations: 越挖越难只会撞上更多漏标正例，把 false-negative 问题放大，正好是当前故障的来源。
对；semi-hard 在「有梯度」和「确定是负」之间取平衡，保留难负例的训练收益又不伤相关性。
退回纯随机负例会重回梯度消失、训练停滞，等于把难负例的好处一并扔掉，矫枉过正。
把高排名候选全标正例会灌进大量噪声正例、破坏训练信号，方向完全错了。
optionExplanations_en: Mining ever harder only hits more unlabeled positives, amplifying the false-negative problem that is the current failure.
Correct — semi-hard balances 'has gradient' against 'certainly negative,' keeping the training benefit of hard negatives without hurting relevance.
Reverting to pure random negatives reinstates vanishing gradients and plateaus, discarding the benefit of hard negatives — an overcorrection.
Labeling all high-ranked candidates as positive injects many noisy positives and corrupts the training signal — entirely wrong direction.

termDefinitions.term: negative difficulty spectrum / 负例难度谱
termDefinitions.meaning: random → semi-hard → hard，越难信息量越大但越可能撞上漏标正例(false negative)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The negative difficulty spectrum runs random to semi-hard to hard; harder gives more signal but more likely hits false negatives.
